title: The Duke and I
author: Julia Quinn
summary: In Regency London, a newly returned duke who wants to avoid marriage and a young woman tired of being chased by suitors agree to pretend to court. Their scheme gives them an excuse to spend time together, and it works a little too well.
readIf: you enjoy Regency ballroom romance with sparkling dialogue and a fake courtship at its centre.
skipIf: you want a modern setting or would rather avoid a hero with a painful father-son history.

pairings.reason: The original model for witty, society-bound courtship if you want to go to the source.
A much more comic, fairy-tale take on love, with plenty of the same cheeky charm.
Another historical romance, but far longer, grittier and sweeping.
